verdict.rationale: Recurly ships configurable, domain-specific automations that run unattended in the background. These include dunning campaigns that control retries and emails, Intelligent Retries, a standalone retry engine that manages the full recovery lifecycle, automatic entitlement grants, and automated revenue recognition. A community comparison corroborates that dunning runs automatically without webhooks. However, these are fixed billing workflows, not general-purpose or AI-driven automations an AI-native user can define. Missing for 10: general user-defined automation/workflow builder, AI/agent-driven background tasks, scheduling or trigger configuration beyond billing workflows.
